title: Juneau Sport Fishing
specs: Fishing in one of the best fishing grounds in Southeast Alaska
Fully equipped luxury boats with warm cabins, bathrooms, and kitchens
Wildlife sightings including whales, eagles, and sea lions
Alaskan 1 Day Sport Fish License required for date of fishing
King Salmon Stamp required to keep King Salmon
Guests aged 15 and under do not need a license or King Stamp
includes: Small snack served during the trip
gap: Cancellation and refund policy not stated
blurb: Guests fish in Southeast Alaska aboard fully equipped luxury boats with warm cabins, bathrooms, and kitchens. Excursions include salmon and bottom fishing around Auke Bay with a US Coast Guard-licensed captain. Fish can be processed locally and shipped home for an additional charge.
extraNote: Fish processing and shipping not included; costs depend on weight, processing type, and shipping distance · No American Express accepted for fish processing · Fish can only be shipped within the US and Canada · Auke Bay, Juneau, Alaska · May – September
